name: Milly
source:
A priest. She has been taking care of Anduke, who has been chained to the Exile Rock since she was born. Since she grew up talking to Anduke, she sometimes forgets her work as a priest when she interacts with him.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071215205316fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/da/char15.html]Mink[/url]]
